_comment: Maria's default-style table for the EAO component layers, as given in MAP-57.
This is the authority, not the .lyrx. Kate applies these colours in ArcGIS and
the ingest translates the .lyrx she delivers, but it refuses the load if what
it translated disagrees with this file. The palette is Okabe-Ito, chosen to be
colourblind-safe: the ticket says not to substitute other hues, which makes
this an accessibility requirement rather than a preference, and one worth
enforcing rather than trusting to a file that is re-exported on a schedule.
Default styles only. Selected-state styling is applied entirely on the app
side and cannot be asserted against a .lyrx, so it does not live here.
Fill and stroke are the same hue for the four EAO categories and the fill is
simply translucent. Only 'uploaded' uses a darker outline than its fill.
Shared across every category: a line feature and a point feature take the
category's own colour, and differ only in how they are drawn. Widths are
screen pixels and the ticket calls them a starting point, which is why they
are compared with a tolerance while the colours are compared exactly.
